text:
marie_support: FYI returned wire for ACME (acct 4472). Returned reason: "Unrecognized intermediary BIC". SWIFT trace: /CORP/INT/XYZBANK/INTMPBK1

kevin_finance: Do we have the outgoing MT103? Need TXN id and payload for reconciliation.

marie_support: TXN rw-2026-4472. Outgoing snippet:
```mt103
:20:rw-2026-4472
:50K:ACME Ltd
:57A:INTMPBK1
:59:/DE89123456781234567890
``` The beneficiary bank says intermediary INTMPBK1 not in their routing table.

wirebot: Automated check: INTMPBK1 not present in SWIFTRef (checked 2026-03-16). Recommend verifying correspondent chain.

alan_ops: Was INTMPBK1 provided by the sender or substituted by our routing? Paste routing logs if available.

marie_support: Plugin substituted it. Routing log: ```2026-03-16T09:12:02Z ROUTE_SUBSTITUTE chosen_intermediary=INTMPBK1 fallback_bic=INTMPBK2``` Not sure why INTMPBK1 was selected instead of INTMPBK2.

emma_payments: INTMPBK1 should not be selectable if it's not in SWIFTRef. @alan_ops can you check the bic-cache, e.g. `redis-cli -h bic-cache --get INTMPBK1`?

alan_ops: Found a stale cache entry: INTMPBK1 existed with empty "verified_until" field — looks like a write race during last week's sync. Flushed the key and restarted bic-sync: `service bic-sync restart`.

kevin_finance: For this $256k wire, do we auto-retry to the same route or issue a manual reverse? Need to confirm customer SLA before proceeding.

marie_support: Proposed plan (ticket INC-2026-9125): 1) Stop auto-retries on returned wires for now. 2) Notify customer and offer an immediate reversal and refund. 3) Reissue the wire with verified intermediary INTMPBK2 after ops confirms route.

emma_payments: Agree. Also gating change: create feature flag FF-5343 to disable auto-substitution to unverified intermediaries for high-value (>100k) wires. Filed.

wirebot: bic-sync completed at 2026-03-16T09:20:10Z — INTMPBK1 removed from cache, INTMPBK2 verified and present.

alan_ops: Re-ran route selection in staging against the same TXN: interceptor selects INTMPBK2. Log: `ROUTE_CHOICE chosen=INTMPBK2 reason=verified_in_swiftref`. Holding on production reissue until finance signs off.

kevin_finance: Sign-off granted for reissue with INTMPBK2. Marie, proceed with reverse + reissue, mark ticket P1 and cc me on the customer email.

marie_support: Reverse initiated and customer notified. Ticket updated INC-2026-9125. Closing note: root cause = stale bic-cache allowed selection of an unverified intermediary. Action items: - alan_ops: add cache validation and flush logic (due 2026-03-20) - emma_payments: enforce FF-5343 for >100k wires - kevin_finance: review returned-wire playbook and SLAs for high-value items.

alan_ops: Adding periodic SWIFTRef diff audit + alert BIC_CACHE_MISMATCH (PD if mismatch count > 0) to catch removals earlier.

marie_support: Will follow up when the reissue clears. :thumbsup:
